WITH route AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-105.004258 39.742011, -105.004253 39.742004, -105.003833 39.741452, -105.003511 39.741029)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
segments AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg
  FROM route r
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT
    ST_StartPoint(seg) AS p1,
    ST_EndPoint(seg)   AS p2,
    ST_Length(seg::geography) AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT
    e.seg_len_m,
    ST_Value(dc.rast, 1, e.p1) AS z1,
    ST_Value(dc.rast, 1, e.p2) AS z2
  FROM endpoints e, dem_clip dc
),
slopes AS (
  SELECT
    seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m ELSE NULL END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
),
avg_grade AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0) AS g
  FROM slopes
  WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT DEGREES(ATAN(g)) AS slope_degrees
FROM avg_grade;

WITH street_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-105.004258 39.742011, -105.004253 39.742004, -105.003833 39.741452, -105.003511 39.741029)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(r.rast, 1, street_geom.geom, true) AS clipped_rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us r,
    street_geom
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(r.rast::geography, street_geom.geom)
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Slope(clipped_rast, 1, '32BF', true) AS slope_rast
  FROM 
    dem_clip
),
slope_values AS (
  SELECT 
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(slope_rast)).val AS slope_value
  FROM 
    slope_raster
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(slope_value)::numeric, 2) AS average_slope_degrees
FROM 
  slope_values;
